verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is that Devin for Terminal runs in your local environment, which covers local execution of the agent. Longer tasks are handed off to cloud Devin, and the VPN and macOS-VM features are Devin-managed cloud workspaces, not self-hosted infrastructure. Missing for 10: self-hosted deployment in containers, deployment on customer-owned VMs, documentation of running the full agent infrastructure (not just a CLI client) on-premises, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can self-host agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on my own VMs

citations.quote: Running Devin for Terminal in your local environment for quick fixes, code exploration, and interactive coding right from the command line
